summary: Iteration 44 - Complete testing of Room Finish Schedule tile extraction feature with offscreen canvas rendering. All backend API tests (8/8) and frontend UI tests passed. The TilePatternCanvas component creates an OFFSCREEN CANVAS from the crop region, then passes that offscreen canvas to drawTilePattern, ensuring the full multi-tile source image is NEVER used for pattern rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: TilePatternCanvas creates offscreen canvas from crop region (line ~402-407) - VERIFIED
drawTilePattern receives offscreen canvas (not full source image) and uses it for all tile rendering - VERIFIED
Auto-crop fallback (center 24% of image) when no tile_crop defined - VERIFIED
Pattern picker shows all 8 patterns and changes trigger canvas re-render - VERIFIED
CROP TILE button opens modal for re-cropping existing placed tile - VERIFIED
Placing NEW tile on empty zone opens crop modal - VERIFIED
Existing crop is reused when placing same tile on another zone - VERIFIED
tile_crop field correctly persisted in backend MaterialEntry model - VERIFIED
Proxy image endpoint (/api/proxy-image) working for CORS bypass - VERIFIED
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo project with 4 tile items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 44 verified the offscreen canvas tile extraction workflow: 1) TilePatternCanvas creates offscreen canvas from crop region, 2) drawTilePattern receives the offscreen canvas (containing ONLY the extracted single tile), 3) Pattern rendering uses the offscreen canvas for all tile slots. The Back Wall has Subway Tile with herringbone pattern and tile_crop={x:36, y:312, w:155, h:168}. Pattern changes (STACKED HORIZONTAL, HERRINGBONE) trigger canvas re-render with the cropped tile. Hexagon Carrara tile was placed on UPPER/ACCENT zone with new crop.
